briefdescription.para: Discovers test modules from the test source set output directory.

detaileddescription.para: Scans for .xtc files and creates XtcRunModule instances for each. Results are sorted by module name for deterministic test execution order.

briefdescription.para: Task that runs XTC xunit tests.

detaileddescription.para: This task extends XtcRunTask to inherit all module running capabilities, adding test-specific behavior like fail-on-failure control.
Tests are configured the same way as run modules - via the xtcTest extension or directly on the task. The task will run the configured test modules and report results.
Test filtering (include/exclude) is handled at the source set level.
